inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "Thundercoast, a stormy coast ruled by a sea tribe of fishmen who build machines under the water and look down on everyone who breathes air, where everything in the sea is electric. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy. A war torn brutal planet where everything wants to kill everything, told with absurd deadpan humour. A section of one wide connected region panorama, refined with crisp pixel clusters.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "bright readable war torn battle stage with absurd deadpan humour, coherent pixel clusters, a real place with depth", "lighting": "Bright sun breaking through storm clouds from the upper left, wet shine on rocks and brass, cool teal shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the sand floor in calm even light.", "color_palette": ["#2a3a52", "#4a6a8a", "#9ac4d8", "#e8f8ff", "#1a6a7a", "#2a9aa8", "#7ad0d0", "#1e2630", "#3a4652", "#b87a3a", "#e0a84a", "#ff7a3a", "#4a8a6a", "#9aa6a2", "#c2c8bc"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "A section of a continuous 2.5D battle stage panorama seen from a fixed side oblique camera, no people: sky above a distant horizon, scenery behind the arena in overlapping rows, a calm empty floor.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 300, 1000], "desc": "a dramatic storm sky of dark slate clouds with bright breaks of sunlight, one jagged lightning bolt striking far away"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [540, 0, 1000, 1000], "desc": "one calm, empty floor of wet grey sand and flat stone slabs running the whole width, a few shallow puddles reflecting the sky, a worn trail along its back edge through all three places"}]}}
